page0.text:
...It's hard to admit it, but it's true.
We're going to be spending time around each other. If I state my opinion clearly, that should at least avoid any misunderstandings.

page1.text:
"...Sorry. To be honest, I have a hard time dealing with you. It's not that I dislike you, but you make me nervous."
The mood grows heavy.
Sakura's just trying to be considerate of me, but this is only going to create more friction with Rider...

page2.text:
"Sakura, you don't need to concern yourself with this. His reaction is a natural one."
"Huh...? No, that's not true, Rider. Senpai's just not used to you yet, but he'll—"

page3.text:
"I said it's fine. I actually feel relieved to hear that. He is speaking the truth.
...Yes. He really is as honest as you said."

page4.text:
...
I'm surprised.
Rider can smile that gently?

page5.text:
"Shirou Emiya. Allow me to ask again—you don't bear any hostility towards me?"
"No. It's hard to approach you, but I don't dislike you."

page6.text:
"That is sufficient. Please continue to keep that attitude.
I am Sakura's Servant. I will always put her first, which may lead me to attack you. It's for the best if we remain cautious of each other."

page7.text:
"R-Rider, stop it! Senpai is important to me, so don't talk to him that way!"
"...All right. Allow me to amend that statement.
As long as you protect Sakura, I will cooperate with you. I hope you will find that satisfactory."
Rider bows politely.

page8.text:
...
I understand her position, now.
I still don't know if we'll end up being enemies, but I can believe that she wants to protect Sakura.

page9.text:
"Okay. Let's both try to make this work."
"Yes, that should make Sakura happy. I will stand guard in the shadows, while you protect her in the light."
Rider's voice is dispassionate.
The conversation dies off there, and we continue eating breakfast in silence.
